Compare hours with roster, contract hours, absence and CAO allowance rules

steps.what: Collect hours, shift allowances, overtime, absence, hires and leavers

loop.input: Mutation mails and attachments from team leads and HR admin that do not come through an AFAS workflow
loop.output: Structured mutation lines (employee number, wage component, period, amount) ready for AFAS import
loop.check: Employee and wage component must exist in AFAS; amounts within CAO limits; unmatched lines rejected
loop.stop: One extraction per document; anything failing checks goes to a review queue, never imported
loop.why_not_simpler: Some managers still send hours and changes as free-text mail; the rest moves to AFAS InSite forms

steps.what: Enter mutations in AFAS and run the payroll calculation
Check the run against last period and find anomalies

loop.input: Rule hits: gross moved beyond threshold, pension stopped while enrolled, leaver still paid, rate below minimum wage, CAO scale mismatch

43-3051.00:2515.enabler_now: Rule checks around the payroll engine are now common practice, and a bounded model can read free-text mutation mails and explain exceptions without touching the calculation.
43-3051.00:2515.still_hard: Keeping CAO rule variants correct, and staff trust: many employees do not want AI near their pay.
43-3051.00:2515.human_edge: Approving the run and the payment, and calling an employee whose pay is wrong, stay with the specialist.

43-3051.00:2515.altitude: The specialist writes and tunes the check rules and approves runs from an exception list, measured on first-time-right runs and corrections per run.

43-3051.00:2516.short: Enter variable pay, calculate exceptions in Excel, run and check the AFAS trial payroll, then finalise.

steps.what: Enter variable pay items and one-off payments into AFAS
Calculate retroactive CAO raises, final settlements and corrections in Excel
Run the trial payroll in AFAS
Compare trial run with last month and hunt for odd results

loop.input: One flagged employee: rule hit, wage components this and last month, contract and absence mutations
loop.output: A two-line likely cause per exception, citing the components that moved
loop.check: Every cited component and amount must match the run data, otherwise the explanation is dropped. Payroll accepts or rejects each one.
loop.stop: One pass per exception, capped at 200 per run; on failure show the raw rule hit with no text
loop.why_not_simpler: Rules find the deviation but cannot say in plain words which mix of mutations caused it; payroll does that by hand today.

steps.what: Finalise run, post journal and send net pay batch to Rabobank

43-3051.00:2516.design: Gross-to-net stays in AFAS Profit. Retroactive raises and final settlements move from Excel into AFAS configuration where possible. A scheduled Python job reads the trial run and checks it against last month and explicit rules, for example: gross pay moved more than expected, pension stopped while still enrolled, leaver paid twice, rate below minimum wage. A bounded model step drafts a short cause for each hit, and payroll approves the run from the report.
43-3051.00:2516.previous_blocker: Comparing runs needed custom reports, and writing plain explanations of exceptions took a person.
43-3051.00:2516.enabler_now: Rule code is cheap to write and test now, and a bounded model step can explain an exception from the structured run data. Vendors already run such checks in production.
43-3051.00:2516.still_hard: Thresholds must be tuned so the list is short enough to read. Retroactive CAO raises across two CAOs stay error-prone, and a wrong check that stays silent is worse than no check.
43-3051.00:2516.human_edge: Judging whether an unusual result is right, for example a large back payment, and deciding to hold or release the run.

ambition.what: A short report for each pay run, for the Controller, with exceptions found, corrections and first-time-right rate.

43-3051.00:18562.short: Collect new-hire documents and key the employee, contract and pay data into AFAS.

Check completeness: ID, BSN, IBAN, tax credit choice, pension data
Enter employee, contract, CAO scale, allowances and pension into AFAS

43-3051.00:18562.design: When a candidate reaches 'hired' in Recruitee, an integration creates an AFAS onboarding workflow pre-filled with offer data. Deterministic checks validate the BSN eleven-test, IBAN check digits, required fields and the CAO scale against the offer. The specialist approves the prepared employee and contract record before it is committed. The first pre-run is then checked against the offer amount automatically.
43-3051.00:18562.previous_blocker: Recruitee and AFAS were not connected, so the offer data was keyed twice. Contract variants across two CAOs made a generic import look risky.
43-3051.00:18562.enabler_now: The Recruitee API and AFAS UpdateConnectors can be stitched in days with AI-assisted coding. Explicit CAO scale tables make the mapping testable.
43-3051.00:18562.still_hard: Off-pattern contracts (individual deals, previous service, part-time on shift patterns) need a person. ID copies hold sensitive data and must be handled under AVG rules (BSN masked, limited retention).
43-3051.00:18562.human_edge: Approving the contract record that sets someone's pay and settling odd agreements with the recruiter or manager.

43-3051.00:2528.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding makes a small matching job and report a matter of days, and bank statement files and AFAS connectors are standard interfaces.
